primary.authentication: anonymous STAC plus official Planetary Computer data API rendering; direct temporary SAS signing retained for offline/local tests

selection.rule: newest item or same-date item set covering the resolved campus detail extent

context.center: supplied CCD coordinate until campus is resolved

detail.center: automatically resolved public campus-polygon center; flagged fallback cases require review

products.target_crs: local WGS 84 UTM zone selected from the product center
products.resampling: bilinear for RGB display derivative; native georeferenced raster retained for measurement

allowed_when: NAIP is materially older than an available contextual view
context is needed to resolve the campus
fallback.capture_vintage_policy: record the exposed local capture vintage; otherwise use unknown (retrieved YYYY-MM-DD)

street_level.reason: avoid billing-enabled services during the free, reproducible pilot
street_level.consequence: aerial-only fencing confidence remains capped by the frozen confidence protocol

manual_adjudication.allowed_only_when: NAIP and the permitted Esri fallback do not support a defensible human decision
manual_adjudication.purpose: human adjudication of exceptional ambiguous fields only
required_record: imagery date or displayed date range when available
manual_adjudication.cross_vintage_rule: never combine facility groups from different imagery states into one count without naming the chosen measurement source and documenting the discrepancy

campus_resolution.primary_method: automatic OpenStreetMap amenity=school polygon match within 1500 metres
flag_conditions: public boundary query or provenance validation failure
campus_resolution.supporting_map_data: OpenStreetMap for the assessment; downloadable OSM or Overture extracts at national scale

scope_modes.authoritative_polygon: trusted OSM or human-approved polygon is the measurement mask
scope_modes.soft_boundary: Gemini polygon controls center and buffered crop size only; entire detail image is searched
scope_modes.center_only: verified center with fixed crop; entire detail image is searched
